verdict.rationale: The Connect API documents batch transaction sync with external-ID idempotence ("Idempotence and deduplication is handled via the external_id field") and auto-books 95%+ of transactions in real time, showing the platform can process many items at once programmatically. However there's no documented bulk-edit UI, bulk categorization/reclassification endpoint, or explicit multi-item action beyond transaction sync and bill workflows. Missing for 10: dedicated bulk-update/bulk-edit endpoints or UI, evidence of bulk operations across other object types (invoices, reports, vendors) beyond transactions, and independent confirmation of batch scale limits.
